controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Size-constrained spherical illustration at the 995 ±80 km thermal diameter. Herschel constrains effective size, not three axes; no resolved global shape or topography is represented. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Published size model; shape unresolved
